item.title: Holiday and Grant power the Trail Blazers to a 122-114 win over the Grizzlies
item.description: Jrue Holiday had 35 points and 11 assists, and Jerami Grant added 30 points as the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a two-game skid with a 122-114 win over the Memphis Grizzlies.

item.title: Austin scores 14 in 4th quarter, Alabama women beat Missouri 65-48 at SEC Tournament
item.description: Ace Austin scored all of her 14 points in the fourth quarter and Alabama beat Missouri 65-48 in the first round of the SEC Tournament and extend the Tigers' skid.

item.title: C.J. Cox rallies No. 15 Purdue past Nick Martinelli and Northwestern 70-66
Punch the orphan macaque is outgrowing his plushie and making friends
item.description: Punch the baby orphan macaque is outgrowing the orangutan plushie that comforted him through early rejection from his mother and other monkeys.

item.title: Davis earned third career double-double for Kansas women in 56-35 win over UCF
item.description: Kansas beats UCF 56 -35 in the opening round of the Big 12 tournament behind a double-double from Jaliya Davis.

item.title: Fanuza Kadirova's late power-play goal lifts Ottawa Charge past Seattle Torrent 4-3
item.description: Fanuza Kadirova scored two goals, including the power-play winner with 1:46 remaining, and the Ottawa Charge beat the Seattle Torrent 4-3.

item.title: Carle Place boys basketball's Ryan Leary scores 21 points to lead Frogs to Nassau Class B crown
item.description: The Frogs will face Suffolk Class B champion Southampton on Tuesday at 5 p.m. at Farmingdale State.

item.title: Flemings, Sharp lead No. 7 Houston past Baylor 77-64
item.description: Kingston Flemings had 21 points and seven assists, Emanuel Sharp added 19 points and No. 7 Houston rallied for a 77-64 win over Baylor.

item.title: Nassau police: Man treated for injuries after West Hempstead house fire
item.description: Firefighters arrived to find the two-story home in flames, according to the authorities.

item.title: Okorie, Dent-Smith lead Stanford over Notre Dame 86-78
item.description: Stanford beats Notre Dame 86 to 78 behind big nights from Ebuka Okorie and Jeremy Dent-Smith.
